name: Runergy Alabama
old_description: We provide high quality & high efficiency solar energy products.
about:
Runergy Alabama operates a solar panel assembly plant in Huntsville, Alabama, established in 2023 when its parent company Runergy USA Inc expanded U.S. manufacturing. The facility is the first of its kind in Alabama to produce N‑type solar panels. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, but the business is a subsidiary of Runergy USA Inc, which is part of a global photovoltaic group.

The company manufactures high‑efficiency solar modules, offering both N‑type and P‑type panels. Its Huntsville plant assembles modules using advanced cell technology, and the firm also develops and installs solar power projects for large‑scale and distributed installations nationwide. Production capacity and headcount figures have not been released.

Runergy Alabama serves the solar energy and photovoltaic industries, targeting utility‑scale developers, commercial and industrial project owners, and residential installers. Its global project experience includes partnerships with research institutes such as Fraunhofer‑ISE and the University of New South Wales.

The company emphasizes innovation driven by partnerships with research institutes, and its N‑type panels are marketed for superior low‑light performance. The corporate ethos highlights humility, practicality, honesty, generosity, and gratitude as guiding principles for delivering reliable, high‑efficiency solar solutions.

name: Rustic Home
old_description: If we don't have what you're looking for in our shop... we'll have it made and customized just for you!
about:
Rustic Home operates a retail furniture store in Albuquerque, New Mexico, at 9304 4th Street NW. The business is owned by Norma, who runs the shop with a personal touch reflected in customer reviews. The founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The store specializes in rustic-style home furnishings, including furniture pieces that are handmade in Mexico and made to order. Inventory also includes throw blankets, pillows, incense, and other accent items suited to Southwestern decor. Each furniture piece exhibits natural variations such as cracks, distressed surfaces, and color differences, which the company describes as giving the items character. The shop does not manufacture products itself but coordinates custom orders with Mexican workshops.

Rustic Home serves individual consumers and interior decorators seeking rustic and Southwestern-style home goods. Customers have noted purchasing multiple pieces for personal residences, and the store attracts shoppers looking for unique, non-uniform furniture and decor accessories.

The company distinguishes itself through a willingness to source custom-made pieces when stock items do not meet a buyer's needs, emphasizing the handmade nature and distinctive imperfections of its Mexican-sourced furniture as a selling point.

name: Rustic furniture designs LLC
old_description: We’re grateful for every family that invites our work into their home.
about:
Rustic Furniture Designs LLC is based in Orrville, Ohio, where it designs and builds solid wood furniture for the residential market. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website presents a catalog of artisan pieces intended to last for generations.

The workshop produces a range of furniture including dining tables, chairs, barstools, hutches, TV stands, wall shelves, charcuterie boards, and specialty items such as fishing pole racks. All pieces are made from solid wood — oak, reclaimed wood, and mixed hardwoods — with no veneers or particle board. The company also accepts custom orders, allowing customers to request tailored dimensions or designs.

Rustic Furniture Designs sells directly to homeowners through its e-commerce site, organizing its catalog into Farmhouse, Midcentury, and Modern collections. Prices range from $30 for small accessories to $1,640 for multi-piece sets. The company does not list commercial or institutional clients.

The business distinguishes itself by emphasizing handcrafted construction and material integrity. Its marketing highlights the absence of engineered wood products and the option for custom work, positioning each piece as an heirloom-quality investment.

name: RxSource (NJ) Inc.
old_description: Putting patients first has been at the heart of everything we do since RxSource was founded in 2005. We have a belief in
about:
RxSource was founded in 2005 in Canada and expanded to the United States in 2018 with a facility in West Deptford, New Jersey. The company operates as a clinical trial supply services provider to the global pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors, with additional sites in Ontario, Canada and Dublin, Ireland. No individual founders are named in the source material, and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The company offers end‑to‑end clinical trial supply services: sourcing of commercial products (comparators, co‑medications, rescue medications, ancillaries), packaging and labelling under temperature‑controlled conditions (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), global temperature‑controlled distribution through its North American and EU facilities and a network of partner depots, Importer of Record services, VAT management, and Qualified Person (QP) release services for the EU. Facilities hold Health Canada Drug Establishment Licences, New Jersey Wholesale Distributor Licences, and HPRA Manufacturer/Importer Authorisations (MIA) and Wholesale Dealer Licences. The quality system is supported by TrackWise EQMS, and the company reports year‑over‑year growth of 27% in units packaged, 103% in packaging runs, and 570% in labels printed.

RxSource serves pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors running clinical trials worldwide. Concrete examples include sourcing comparator drugs, co‑medications, rescue medications and ancillary supplies, as well as providing labelling, kitting, and distribution for trial materials across multiple temperature ranges.

The company states its differentiating purpose is a "patient‑first" philosophy, aiming to improve the lives of 10 million patients in ten years. It emphasizes industry‑timelines, flexible capacity planning, an experienced team, and a quality‑first approach that goes beyond regulatory minimums.

name: S&W Wire Co
old_description: Textile covering consisting of pure fiberglass yarn, which is wrapped, treated, and then heat fused to the underlying conductor. Can be constructed with a single layer or double layer of glass yarn.
about:
S&W Wire Co. operates from Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania. The company was founded in 1988 to meet demand for quick-turnaround production of glass- and Kapton-insulated magnet wire. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm manufactures enameled magnet wire, polyglass-insulated wire, and hollow conductor tubing in square, rectangular, and round profiles. It maintains an inventory of up to 150,000 pounds across more than 200 sizes, supplemented by a computerized link to North America’s largest wire inventories. Services include magnet-wire testing for specification and batch uniformity, stocking programs tailored to supply-chain schedules, and a wire-on-demand suite that offers exact-length cutting and respooling with no minimum order quantities.

S&W Wire serves a broad base of magnet-wire buyers, from small-volume users to large-scale manufacturers, though specific industry sectors or named customers are not identified in its public materials.

The business was created to fill a gap for rapid delivery of specialized insulated magnet wire. Its stated differentiators include no-minimum ordering, daily-updated inventory access, and in-house testing capabilities that support quality control.

name: SCSP Solar

about:
SCSP Solar operates from Charleston, South Carolina, as a family-owned and operated solar installation company. The firm leverages more than 30 years of combined expertise in clean energy, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. The team includes personnel such as Jon Mason, Nick, and Tayler, who appear in customer reviews as points of contact for design and project management.

The company provides full-service residential and commercial solar solutions, handling custom system design, permitting, paperwork, installation, and ongoing monitoring. SCSP Solar does not manufacture its own equipment; instead, it partners with selective manufacturers to supply what it describes as sleek, award-winning panels and components that outperform industry standards. Installations are typically completed in one day, according to customer accounts, and the firm offers warranties covering the life of the system.

SCSP Solar serves homeowners and businesses across South Carolina and into neighboring North Carolina. Reviews cite projects in Mount Pleasant, Bowling Green, Okatie, North Augusta, and Hickory, NC. The company emphasizes tailored solutions that match specific energy needs and aesthetic preferences, and it assists customers in accessing the 30% federal tax credit and any available state rebates.

The company positions itself on a hassle-free, personalized experience from education through activation and maintenance. Its certified designers build custom systems to maximize power performance and curb appeal, and the firm highlights its communication and craftsmanship as differentiators in a market where customers often compare multiple installers.

name: SE-MAR Electric Company, Inc.
old_description: Industrial control panels, electrical cabinets, and enclosures, in-house since 1990
about:
SE-MAR Electric Company, Inc. was founded in 1990 in West Seneca, New York, a suburb of Buffalo. The company operates from a facility on South Avenue and serves customers worldwide from its Western New York base.

The company designs, manufactures, and installs custom industrial control panels, electrical cabinets, and enclosures. Its in-house capabilities include control panel fabrication, orbital welding, process tubing, cable and collector bus assembly, PLC cabinet integration, and AutoCAD drafting. SE-MAR also provides industrial electrical manufacturing, pneumatic control panels, rectifier enclosures, and drive installation and start-up services. The firm acts as a process skid manufacturer and offers engineering support for custom systems and drives.

SE-MAR serves commercial and industrial manufacturers across multiple sectors, shipping globally from its Western New York location. Its client base includes facilities requiring custom control panels, process skids, and electrical engineering services. The company also supplies components such as solid-state starters, transformers, and power supplies from brands including Adalet and Siemens.

SE-MAR emphasizes its certified control panel technicians and comprehensive in-house design-to-installation workflow as key differentiators. The company highlights its ability to deliver turnkey solutions — from AutoCAD design through fabrication, welding, and on-site installation — to help customers increase productivity and streamline operations.

name: SEC America
old_description: SEC Tractor Trailer Electrical Interfaces provide electrical compatibility when electrical specifications between tractor and trailer do not match.
about:
SEC America Corp operates from South Burlington, Vermont, where it has developed power conversion solutions for more than three decades. The company was founded as a design and engineering firm specializing in the supply of electricity, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not indicated in available sources.

The company designs, engineers, and assembles rugged power conversion products in the United States. Its portfolio includes DC-DC converters, battery backups, sealed converters, and trailer electrical interfaces that resolve electrical mismatches between tractors and trailers. SEC America maintains engineering facilities for rapid prototype development and field test monitoring, along with in-house transformer and metal fabrication capabilities that support design management and product refinement. An extensive inventory of standard off-the-shelf units is warehoused at the South Burlington location, enabling same-day shipment for orders placed before 1:00 PM Eastern time. Custom design and private labeling services are also offered, with the engineering staff tailoring mechanical and electrical specifications to customer requirements.

SEC America serves industrial and consumer specialty markets, with a focus on original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that require power conversion solutions. Its trailer electrical interfaces target the heavy-duty transportation sector, while its broader product line addresses diverse industrial and consumer applications. The company emphasizes a design/build process that adapts existing designs for small and medium runs and pursues custom development for large-volume programs.

The company differentiates itself through U.S. assembly, rapid delivery on new designs, and a commitment to rugged, built-to-last products. Continuous communication with manufacturing partners is cited as a driver of cost-effective assemblies and packaging. A two-year limited warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship, and warranty and non-warranty repair services are handled at the Vermont facility.
